# A file stating `took_the_residual` on a split of a transaction that is not
# stated in the book's own currency.
#
# Both accounts are in US dollars, so the transaction is stated in US dollars,
# and the marked split is an expense — a realized difference is a gain or a
# loss, so putting it anywhere else would be turned away by the account before
# the currency was ever asked about. This is the currency rule on its own.
#
# The 20.00 below is US dollars. Counted, it would be added into a Canadian
# total with no price applied to it and nothing on the page saying the units
# differ — the sum states one currency, and a figure in another cannot join it.
#
# Nothing here gives a cost basis guid, and nothing needs to: the currency is
# asked about before the disposal is.
2026-03-01 open Expenses
	type: "Expense"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-03-01 open Expenses:USD Bank Fees
	type: "Expense"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

2026-03-01 * "Bank fee charged in US dollars"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:USD Bank -20.00 USD
	Expenses:USD Bank Fees 20.00 USD
		took_the_residual: "true"
